You leave here as a trained ''weapon'' of the Imperial Navy… or you don't leave here at all. Welcome to Carida Academy, cadets.|Triosa Broog welcomes a new class of cadets|}} The '''Carida Academy''', also known as the '''Imperial Naval Academy''', and once known as the '''Academy of Carida''' and the '''Carida Military Academy''', was a military academy on [[Carida]] which, during the [[Imperial Era|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire]], was an [[Imperial Academy]] for its military training program. The academy was built on the edge of a cliff. Multiple landing pads emerged from the side of the cliff face. Like the [[Raithal Academy|academies]] at [[Raithal]] and [[Corulag]], it was a specialized service academy for [[Imperial officer|officer]] training. The [[Imperial Army|Army]], [[Imperial Navy|Navy]], and [[Stormtrooper Corps]] officers all trained there. Two notable instructors were [[Captain]] [[Tabor Seitaron]], who taught military history to [[cadet]]s there, and [[Sergeant]] [[Triosa Broog]], who served as [[training officer]] to cadet [[Han Solo]] before he was expelled and reassigned to [[infantry]] on [[Mimban]] for chronic insubordination and recklessness. ==Organization== {{Quote|Cadets are the ''property'' of the Empire. They may leave this academy as a trained weapon, or—''"
"''—as a ''corpse''. I keep hearing that.|Yurib Nakan and Han Solo|[[Han Solo - Imperial Cadet 2|''Han Solo - Imperial Cadet'' 2]]}} Carida Academy''[[Battlefront: Twilight Company]]'' was a military academy and university''[[The High Republic: Out of the Shadows]]'' located high in the [[mountain]]s of [[Carida]],[[Han Solo - Imperial Cadet 1|''Han Solo - Imperial Cadet'' 1]] a [[planet]]''[[Star Wars: Geektionary: The Galaxy from A - Z]]'' located in the [[Colonies]]'[[Star Wars Galaxy Map (poster)|''Star Wars'' Galaxy Map poster]] [[Carida system]].{{TCW|Point of No Return (The Clone Wars)}} Once a training camp for the [[Galactic Republic]]'s [[Republic army|army]],{{EncyclopediaCite|Prologue to the Clone Wars and the First Battle of Geonosis}} the Academy of Carida trained students in the arts of warfare and diplomacy. It also had a hyperspace theory and philosophy department. [[File:NewCadetsCarida-HanImperialCadet1.png|thumb|left|350px|Carida Academy trained Imperial cadets to be pilots and officers]] During the [[Imperial Era|time]] of the [[Galactic Empire]], Carida Academy included a specialized service academy to provide [[Imperial officer|officer]] training to [[Imperial cadet]]s which exceeded basic-training academies like the [[Academy for Young Imperials]] on the''[[Servants of the Empire: Rebel in the Ranks]]'' [[Outer Rim Territories]] [[planet]]{{Databank|lothal|Lothal}} [[Lothal]]. It also served as the Imperial Naval Academy for [[cadet]]s that had enlisted for the [[Imperial Navy]], training [[Imperial Starfighter Pilot]]s. The cadets were treated as property of the Empire and it was considered that they would leave the academy as either trained military personnel or corpses. ==Curriculum== {{Quote|You no longer have names. You are ''only numbers. If '' you survive your training, you will earn back your name and a place in the flight-training program. Most of you will wash out ''before'' selection event begins.|Triosa Broog addresses a new class of cadets|}} During the induction to the Imperial Naval Academy, cadets had their [[hair]] deloused and cut and civilian [[Clothing|clothes]] removed by droids, replaced with [[Color|white]] Imperial cadet uniform with black [[boot]]s. Cadets were addressed by their call number rather than names. The cadets were then put into basic training under a [[training officer]]. These involved a series of ground-based exercises that filtered off cadets, one of which involved enduring an assault course in [[Imperial Army trooper]] uniform. Cadets who made it through were given back their names and a selection process chose who would go into flight training. [[File:Leaderboard-HanImperialCadet2.png|thumb|right|280px|A class leaderboard at Carida Academy]] At the next stage of their training, cadets went through more specialized exercises, including underwater training in [[seatrooper]] gear, and parachuting. Additionally, they were taught about Imperial [[starfighter]]s before they went into the cockpits of [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter|TIE fighters]] and put through exercises where they maneuvered between obstacles including [[turbolaser]] [[cannon]]s. One included working as pairs to destroy a [[Deflector shield|shielded]] cannon. [[Deflector shield generator dome]]s also served as exercise targets.[[TIE Fighter 4|''TIE Fighter'' 4]] Another exercise involved travelling across open [[Realspace|space]] or crewing larger vessels such as [[Quasar Fire-class cruiser-carrier|''Quasar Fire''-class cruiser carriers]] if they had recently received discipline.[[Han Solo - Imperial Cadet 3|''Han Solo - Imperial Cadet'' 3]] In the meantime, cadets were ranked based on their piloting skills and their academic achievements via class leader boards. For the next stage of training, cadets were deployed into real combat situations in their own [[squadron]]s. [[Carida Squadron]][[Han Solo - Imperial Cadet 4|''Han Solo - Imperial Cadet'' 4]] and [[Onyx Squadron]]''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story: Expanded Edition]]'' were both academy squadrons made up primarily of cadets. For discipline, cadets could be confined to the brig or ordered to make soup. For more serious infractions such as insubordination, cadets could be dismissed from the Academy and reassigned to other Imperial military service branches.[[Solo: A Star Wars Story Adaptation 1|''Solo: A Star Wars Story Adaptation'' 1]] ==Campus== [[File:HanArrivesAtCarida-HanImperialCadet1.jpg|thumb|left|300px|The Carida Academy's TIE fighter landing field.]] The Carida Academy was constructed on the edge of a cliff, with multiple [[Hangar|landing pads]] emerging from the cliff face. The Academy's facilities included an assembly area, brig for holding troublesome cadets, a landing field for TIE fighters, mess hall,, and barracks. The Academy was guarded by [[stormtrooper]]s and [[Imperial Navy Trooper|Imperial Navy troopers]]. ==History== ===Galactic Republic=== ====First glory days==== {{Quote|Carida is more than a military academy. Those who graduate from here do great things.|Oppo Rancisis|''[[The High Republic: Tempest Runner]]''}} In the earlier days of the Galactic Republic, Carida Academy was a training camp and trained much of the Republic army. During the High Republic Era, it trained students in the arts of warfare and conflict resolution. Since [[the galaxy]] at that time was largely peaceful, most of its students came from worlds facing conflict. The [[Gungan]] theoretical [[hyperspace]] physicist [[Professor]] [[Thaddeus Wolk]] led the university's hyperspace theory and philosophy department. Around [[255 BBY]],''[[The High Republic: Tempest Runner]]'' establishes that [[Lourna Dee]] enrolled at the Carida Academy around [[255 BBY]]. the [[human]] [[Wilson]] and [[Selkath]] [[Lalutin]] held the rank of [[Senior Cadet|senior cadet]] at the Carida military academy.''[[The High Republic: Tempest Runner]]'' [[File:ChanceyYarrow-THRS.png|thumb|right|250px|Chancey Yarrow studied theoretical hyperspace physics at the Academy.]] [[Chancey Yarrow]] was a doctoral student at the Carida Academy researching the use of artificial [[gravity well]]s to pull [[starship]]s out of hyperspace, but her topic was considered insane by her faculty and peers. To please the Academy's requirements, Yarrow pretended to change her topic but secretly continued her research into gravity wells. When her misconduct was discovered, she was expelled. Yarrow subsequently sold her skills and expertise to the [[Nihil]] [[Pirate|marauders]] and the [[Graf family]]. Around the same [[time]], the [[Twi'lek]] [[Lourna Dee]] enrolled in the Carida Military Academy using the name of her [[Death|deceased]] brother [[Inun]], after being [[Attack on the Zygerrian camp|freed]] from a [[Unidentified Zygerrian camp|Zygerrian camp]] by [[Jedi Master]] [[Oppo Rancisis]] and his [[Padawan]], [[Dal Azim]]. Dee eventually [[Escape from Carida|fled]] the academy after getting into a serious fight with two older [[cadet]]s who had been bullying her, seriously injuring them before escaping in a stolen [[starfighter]], subsequently becoming a [[mercenary]]. ====Age of remilitarization==== During the late days of the Republic, [[Kendal Ozzel]], the son of a wealthy family on Carida,{{EncyclopediaCite|Imperial Officers and Agents}} attended Carida Academy,{{StoryCite|story=The Final Order|book=From a Certain Point of View: The Empire Strikes Back}} as well as a number of schools in the [[Core Worlds]]. After Ozzel became an [[Republic officer|officer]] in the [[Republic Military]], he was assigned as a teacher at Carida Academy by his superiors due to his limitations in leading a field mission. The [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]] was [[Raxus Address|founded]]''[[Rise of the Separatists]]'' in [[24 BBY]]''[[Rise of the Separatists]]'' dates the [[Raxus Address|beginning]] of the Separatist Crisis to two [[Standard year|years]] before the [[Clone Wars]], which ''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates as beginning in [[22 BBY]]. Therefore, the Separatist Crisis must have begun in 24 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|BBY]]. as an opposition to the Republic, sparking the [[Separatist Crisis]]. In the midst of the political turmoil, the [[Military Creation Act]] was proposed in the Republic's [[Galactic Senate]]. Benefiting from it the Carida Military Academy, the Carida government backed the bill and offered more than two million [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]] to the campaign supporting it. The Separatist Crisis ended with the outbreak of the [[Clone Wars]] in [[22 BBY]].''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' In the chaos of the war, Ozzel went into active service. Sometime during the conflict,[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story Graphic Novel Adaptation|''Rogue One: A Star Wars Story'' Graphic Novel Adaptation]] a [[Anti-military protest at the Carida Academy|protest]] against the increasing militarization of the Galactic Republic was held at the Carida Academy. According to Andor's [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]] file,{{SW|url=news/cassian-andor-101-the-story-of-a-rebel|text=Cassian Andor 101: The Story of a Rebel|nolive=1}} [[Cassian Jeron Andor's father|Andor's father]] was killed during the protest while the protest was clashing against [[clone trooper]]s. That information, however, may have been false. Indeed, Andor himself had been adopted{{Andor|Reckoning (episode)}} by that point.{{SW|url=series/andor/andor-season-1-episode-3-episode-guide|text="Reckoning" Episode Guide | Andor}} ===Galactic Empire=== ====Continuation under the New Order==== {{Quote|This facility is basic—progress far enough as servants of the Empire and one day you might see what a course on Raithal or even Carida is like.|Cumberlayne Aresko, to cadets of the Academy for Young Imperials|}} The Republic was replaced by the Empire in at the end of the Clone Wars in [[19 BBY]], and the Empire continued to use Carida Academy as a training place for Imperial officers and naval personnel like pilots. [[Niles Gavla]] and [[Danith Nodar]] were graduates of the Imperial Academy.''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story The Official Guide]]'' [[Captain]] [[Tabor Seitaron]], a veteran of the Republic and Empire's navies, taught military history in Carida Academy after retiring from active duty by [[14 BBY]].''[[Battlefront: Twilight Company]]'' establishes that Tabor Seitaron's active service predated the design of the ''[[Herald]]'', which ''[[Star Wars: The Rebel Files]]'' established was an [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]]. The [[Star Destroyer]] model appears as early as ''[[Star Wars Jedi: Fallen Order]]'', which took place five [[Standard year|years]] after the fall of the [[Great Jedi Purge]]. Since ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates the purge to [[19 BBY]], the earliest inclusion of the ''Imperial II''-class must have been in [[14 BBY]] and Seitaron must have retired by that year. In his classes, he had a tendency to mark down students who regurgitated the [[Commission for the Preservation of the New Order]]'s official version of history over what he believed had actually taken place, one of those being [[Tian Karmiya]]. Karmiya was rumored to have reported two cadets who were doing better than her for selling their answers, getting the pair expelled and taking their place. In 14 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|BBY]],''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of [[Tarkin (novel)|''Tarkin'']] to [[14 BBY]]. a [[Berch Teller's rebel cell|rebel cell]] led by [[Berch Teller]] led a [[Berch Teller campaign|campaign]] against Imperial installations with the help of an informant in the Empire's ranks, [[Vice Admiral]] [[Dodd Rancit]], using [[Grand Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin]]'s stolen starship ''[[Carrion Spike]]''. However, they led Rancit into believing that they were going to attack the Carida Academy with the ''Carrion Spike''. As a result, the Academy and Carida were placed under alert and Imperial forces were dispatched to defend the Academy. Rancit intended to destroy the ''Carrion Spike'' and insurgents in order to conceal his role in aiding the insurgents. However, he was exposed by the [[Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]] who took control of Rancit's [[Secutor-class Star Destroyer|''Secutor''-class Star Destroyer]] and executed the Vice Admiral. The ''Carrion Spike'' was subsequently recovered. ====Class of 13 BBY==== =====Initial training===== {{Quote|I am training officer Triosa Broog. And you… are now part of something far more important than your insignificant individual lives. You are now part of an ''Empire''.|Triosa Broog's first address to Han Solo's class|}} [[File:HanCanExplain-HanImperialCadet1.png|thumb|right|250px|Han Solo was an Imperial cadet before becoming a smuggler and rebel leader.]] To escape his [[homeworld]] of [[Corellia]], the criminal [[Han Solo]] enlisted into the Imperial Navy''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]'' in [[13 BBY]]''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story The Official Guide]]'' establishes that the events of ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]'' begin nine [[Standard year|years]] after the [[Proclamation of the New Order|founding]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]. ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates the Empire's founding to [[19 BBY]], meaning the events of ''Solo'' can be placed in [[10 BBY]]. Because the prologue takes place three years prior, the prologue must take place in [[13 BBY]]. and became an Imperial cadet at the Carida Academy. His class included [[Beilert Valance]] from the planet [[Chorin]],[[Bounty Hunters 3|''Bounty Hunters'' 3]] the twins [[Lyttan Dree|Lyttan]] and [[Tamu Dree]] from [[Boiyuh]], [[Kanina Nico]] from the [[Huru system]],[[Han Solo - Imperial Cadet 4|''Han Solo - Imperial Cadet'' 4]] and [[Jarwen]]. Solo continuously came at odds with his fellow cadets during basic training, notably Valance, as well as his training officer, [[Sergeant]] [[Triosa Broog]]. Solo eventually chose to try and desert on a TIE fighter. Although his escape attempt failed, he was able to outfly all of the pursuing security with the exception of [[Flight instructor]] [[Yurib Nakan]]. Solo was put into the brig with the common punishment for desertion being termination. However, Nakan saw great abilities in Solo's flying, as well as rebelliousness that reminded the instructor of himself. Solo, Valance, Nico, Jarwen, and the Drees continued through to flight training, Valance being the top ranked in their class. Although initially at the bottom of the leaderboard, Solo began climbing up to second through her performance in flight exercises alone. During an exercise where pilots were put into pairs, Jarwen was killed, and Solo saved Tamu's life during a flight exercise, earning him the respect of the Dree brothers. However, the cadets in the exercise ultimately failed, and were tasked with making soup for the rest of the cadets in the academy. While Valance was relieved earlier to TIE fighter training, Solo, Nico and the Dree brothers were tasked with delivering the training squadron including Valance aboard [[Imperial Cruiser 07200823]], a ''Quasar Fire''-class cruiser-carrier. During the mission, the four visited a [[Pantolomin cruiser]] where Solo escaped the [[Ithorian]] criminal [[Pjolan]], who was seeking to collect Lady [[Proxima]]'s bounty on Solo. =====Dropouts===== {{Quote|I'm working my way back to flying ''TIEs'' to serve the Empire like you.''"
"''Son…the Empire has ''already'' taken what it can from you. ''Literally,'' as far as I can see.|Beilert Valance and Tarl Sokoli|[[Bounty Hunters 19|''Bounty Hunters'' 19]]}} As their training progressed, Solo and his fellow cadets were later assigned to Carida Squadron, which participated in the [[mission on Qhulosk]] on the planet [[Qhulosk]]. During the battle, Valance was shot down, leading Solo and his cadet companions to defy orders by embarking on a mission behind enemy lines to rescue Valance. Despite saving Valance's life, Solo was sent to the brig for insubordination. Meanwhile, Nico intentionally disappeared on the rescue mission to return to her [[Unidentified planet (Kanina Nico)|homeworld]], and Tamu Dree was transferred into the medical branch his brother remaining at Carida. Valance himself was left with a missing [[eye]] and right [[Limb|leg]], being informed he was permanently grounded due to his failure during the battle. The [[Imperial Army]] being his most ideal prospects for Valance, but he was determined stay on track for an Imperial Navy career.[[Bounty Hunters 10|''Bounty Hunters'' 10]] [[File:ValanceSokoliCarida-BountyHunters19.jpg|thumb|left|350px|Tarl Sokoli bumped into Cadet Valance during his visit to Carida Academy]] Solo remained at the Academy, and Valance began working towards being fly-worthy again. One day, [[Captain]] [[Tarl Sokoli]], the officer who inspired Valance to join the Empire, visited Carida Academy for a talk. Valance rushed to attend it, with Solo joining him, when the pair bumped into Sokoli himself. Valance told the captain about how he was an inspiration, but Sokoli, having become disillusioned and cynical about the Empire's cause, apologized for inspiring the cadet and told him he would never fly again. Solo and Lyttan Dree were eventually assigned to Onyx Squadron, under [[Onyx Leader]] [[Ubbel]] for a mission flying [[TIE/rb heavy starfighter]]s. During the mission, they skirmished with raiders, and Solo disobeyed orders and broke formation to save Dree. As a result, Solo was put on [[Tribunal of Han Solo|trial]] under [[Commodore]] [[Almudin]], who had him expelled from the Academy and reassigned to the Imperial Army on the planet [[Mimban]]. Dree was successful in becoming a TIE pilot in the Imperial Navy, eventually joining in the Empire's [[204th Imperial Fighter Wing]].[[TIE Fighter 1|''TIE Fighter'' 1]] ====The war effort==== {{Quote|The Imperial Navy has commandeered the entire class of cadets for the latest war effort. Whether they're ready or not.''"
"''…We're going to space.''"
"''As the top two ranked in your class, you've been requested by the 204th. They've had some recent losses.|Yurib Nakan and Rac Syrmo|}} [[File:RoSyrmoNakan-TIEFighter4.png|thumb|right|350px|Rac Syrmo and Bansu Ro are told about their reassignment by Yurib Nakan.]] In [[5 BBY]],''[[Servants of the Empire: Rebel in the Ranks]]'' takes place concurrently to "[[Breaking Ranks]]," which ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates to [[5 BBY]]. [[Commandant]] [[Cumberlayne Aresko]] of the Academy for Young Imperials on Lothal described the Carida Academy and the [[Raithal Academy]] as potential destinations for Lothal cadets who had progressed sufficiently in their training. During the [[Galactic Civil War]] between the Empire and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]], [[Bansu Ro]] and [[Rac Syrmo]] were among a class of cadets being trained under Nakan. The pair were at heavy competition with each other, and became the top ranked in the class. However, Ro's career prospects were tainted as his [[Bansu Ro's family|family]] had sided with rebels, setting him on course to be a shuttle pilot.''[[Victory's Price: An Alphabet Squadron Novel]]'' That was until the Imperial Navy chose to commandeer the class for the war effort. The 204th had suffered two casualties, one of them being Dree,[[TIE Fighter 3|''TIE Fighter'' 3]] and requested to take in Ro and Syrmo as the top two in their class. The pair were informed of their immediate transfer following a training exercise in TIE fighters. ==Faculty and staff== *[[Sergeant]]/[[Training officer]] [[Triosa Broog]] *[[Flight instructor]] [[Yurib Nakan]] *[[Teacher]] [[Kendal Ozzel]] *[[Captain]] [[Reese]] *Captain [[Tabor Seitaron]] *An [[Unidentified Carida Military Academy instructor|instructor]] *Captain [[Nettic Whain]] *[[Professor]] [[Thaddeus Wolk]] ==Cadets and alumni== [[File:TIEBrute-SaS.png|thumb|right|270px|Cadets take off from the launch deck flying a TIE/rb Heavy and TIE/ln fighters.]] *[[Lourna Dee]] {{C|as Inun}} *[[Lyttan Dree]]— reached the [[military rank]] of [[lieutenant]] within the [[204th Imperial Fighter Wing]].[[TIE Fighter 3|''TIE Fighter'' 3]] *[[Tamu Dree]] *[[Niles Gavla]]— reached the military rank of lieutenant.''[[Star Wars: Rogue One: The Ultimate Visual Guide]]'' *[[Jarwen]] *[[Tian Karmiya]]— reached the military rank of [[commander]] and served as the [[executive officer]] of the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer|ISD]] ''[[Ultimatum]]''. *[[Lalutin]] *[[Kanina Nico]] *[[Danith Nodar]] *[[Kendal Ozzel]]— reached the military rank of [[Fleet Admiral|fleet admiral]], serving in the vaunted [[Death Squadron]] [[task force]].''[[Star Wars: The Rise and Fall of the Galactic Empire]]'' *[[Han Solo]] *[[Rac Syrmo]] *[[Bansu Ro]] *[[Wilson]] *[[Beilert Valance]] *[[Chancey Yarrow]] ==Behind the scenes== Carida Academy was first mentioned in the [[2014]] novel [[Tarkin (novel)|''Tarkin'']], written by [[James Luceno]]. It was subsequently identified in the [[2015]] novel ''[[Battlefront: Twilight Company]]'', written by [[Alexander Freed]]. The academy made its first appearance in ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story: Expanded Edition]]'', a novel written by [[Mur Lafferty]] and published on [[September 4]] [[2018]]{{PenguinRandomHouse|url=books/574532/solo-a-star-wars-story-expanded-edition-by-mur-lafferty|text=Solo: A Star Wars Story: Expanded Edition}} which served as an extended adaptation of [[Ron Howard]]'s film ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]'', released earlier that year on [[May 25]].{{SW|url=news/christopher-miller-and-phil-lord-to-helm-han-solo-anthology-film|text=Christopher Miller and Phil Lord to Helm Han Solo Anthology Film|nolive=1}} Carida Academy was first visually depicted in [[Han Solo - Imperial Cadet 1|''Han Solo - Imperial Cadet'' 1]], the first issue the ''[[Star Wars: Han Solo - Imperial Cadet]]'' [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] series, written by [[Robbie Thompson]] and published by [[Marvel Comics]] on [[November 7]] of 2018.{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/71582/star_wars_han_solo_-_imperial_cadet_2018_1|text=Star Wars: Han Solo - Imperial Cadet (2018) #1}} The comic issue identified it as the Imperial Naval Academy. The [[2021]] novel ''[[The High Republic: Out of the Shadows]]'', written by [[Justina Ireland]], introduced the name Academy of Carida, while the [[2022]] audio drama ''[[The High Republic: Tempest
